name: review-3578
description: Fix Deferred Reply Placeholders in Active Deferred Buffers
author: eifrah-aws

maintainer_comments.author: ranshid
maintainer_comments.body:
When the deferred reply buffer is active, addReplyDeferredLen now correctly adds the placeholder to c->deferred_reply, but trimReplyUnusedTailSpace(c) still always operates on 
c->reply:


This is not a correctness bug — trimming c->reply is harmless. However, the purpose of the trim is to reclaim wasted tail space before adding a new node. When deferred reply is 
active, the trim should target c->deferred_reply instead, since that's where the placeholder is going. As-is, the trim is a no-op in

maintainer_comments.author: ranshid
maintainer_comments.body:
The pthread_create in OnKeyspaceNotification doesn't detach or join the thread:

This is consistent with other test modules (e.g., block_keyspace_notification.c:72), so it's an existing pattern. Not a blocker, but pthread_detach(tid) after a successful create 
would be cleaner since the thread is fire-and-forget.
